defect_observations.observation: The general nonlinear derivation leaves the step Var(L)=Df(m) Sigma Df(m)^T implicit: the affine theorem is not applied to L in the body or in the Taylor-bound proof. It is written only for the impedance instance (annex lines 335-336). This is not treated as a coverage gap, because L is visibly affine and the affine theorem is general.

The end-gauge measurement equation uses l, d, alpha, alpha_S, theta and theta_S without defining them in prose. Their roles can be recovered only from the budget-table row names (lines 556-564) and lines 601-602. The table's 'supplied' entry for the mean bed temperature (line 561) gives no information source.

The Gaussian next-order proof introduces the Cov(A,C) computation with 'Similarly'. It names the ingredients but does not expand the three pairings. This is a supporting result, not an owed derivation.
The S_Ti=0 characterization invokes 'the measurable-factorization result for real coordinate tuples' without a cross-reference to a stated lemma.

The text says Saltelli and Annoni 'give computational recipes for independent inputs only'. At p.1512, Section 5.4, the article points to Saltelli (2002) and Saltelli et al. (2010) for the independent-input recipe and to other works for the dependent case; it gives no recipe itself. This is a minor attribution imprecision.

Section 172.6 covers the model-assumption half of ED26-GAP-SCI-005-C04 only through its cross-reference to the chapter tagged 172.7-172.10 (w02b-p15-069). The 172.6 hosts alone cover the range half (thm:p15-global-ranking). They would be partial for this component if that chapter were removed or rerouted.
